panels.description: Unique detections in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS TotalDetections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids)

panels.title: Total detections

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS NewDetections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND status = 'new' AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids)

SELECT count() AS HighCritical FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND severity IN ('high', 'critical') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids)

SELECT $__timeInterval(detected_at) AS time, severity, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time

SELECT severity, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY severity ORDER BY detections DESC

SELECT rule_name, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY rule_name ORDER BY detections DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT platform, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY platform ORDER BY detections DESC

SELECT source_type, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY detections DESC

SELECT host_name, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND host_name != '' AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY host_name ORDER BY detections DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT user_name, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND user_name != '' AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY user_name ORDER BY detections DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT source_ip, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND source_ip != '' AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY source_ip ORDER BY detections DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT destination_ip, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND destination_ip != '' AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY destination_ip ORDER BY detections DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT tactic, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL ARRAY JOIN mitre_tactics AS tactic WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY tactic ORDER BY detections DESC

SELECT technique, count() AS detections FROM fusion.detections FINAL ARRAY JOIN mitre_techniques AS technique WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) GROUP BY technique ORDER BY detections DESC

SELECT detected_at AS Detected, severity AS Severity, status AS Status, rule_name AS Rule, platform AS Platform, host_name AS Host, user_name AS User, process_path AS Process, command_line AS CommandLine, source_ip AS SourceIP, destination_ip AS DestinationIP, signature AS Signature, arrayStringConcat(mitre_technique_ids, ', ') AS MITRE, source_event_uid AS SourceEventUID FROM fusion.detections FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND match(severity, '${severity:regex}') AND match(status, '${status:regex}') AND match(platform, '${platform:regex}') AND match(host_name, '${host:regex}') AND match(rule_id, '${rule:regex}') AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${tactic:regex}'), mitre_tactics) AND arrayExists(item -> match(item, '${technique:regex}'), mitre_technique_ids) ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 500
